name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Hanging Decor with Charms And Beads
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from durable 2-layer wood, each 3mm thick for a sturdy and lightweight finished piece.
    - Each wooden sign layer has a thickness of 3mm.
    - Charms are made from 3mm wood for a cohesive and durable design.
    - Includes natural jute rope and wooden beads for a rustic, decorative look.
    - Smooth surface with neat finishing, suitable for long-term indoor display.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available Sizes:  
           +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
           +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    - Minimum charm size: 2 cm.
    - Included jute rope length: 2 meters.
    - Wooden beads diameter: Ø 1 cm.
    - Maximum number of wooden beads included: 20 beads.
    📌 Note: The dimensions of product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Features double-sided printing on the wooden sign and charms.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a hanging decor piece for bedrooms, nurseries, playrooms, and living spaces.
    - Comes with hanging charms and beads to create a layered and eye-catching decorative effect.
    - Jute rope allows easy hanging on walls, doors, hooks, or decorative stands.
    - Ideal for personalizing room décor with names, themes, or custom artwork.
    - Works well as a boho, rustic, or whimsical decorative accent.
    - Suitable for everyday home decoration or themed seasonal displays.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for baby showers, birthdays, and name reveal gifts.
    - Great for nursery décor, kids’ room décor, and room makeovers.
    - Ideal for housewarmings, holidays, and seasonal decorating.
    - A thoughtful choice for Christmas, Thanksgiving, and family celebrations.
    - Suitable for new parents, children, friends, and loved ones who enjoy personalized home décor.

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
